facts.value: The module is designed to serve as an introduction to basic concepts and theories in linguistics. The various subfields and branches of linguistics will be introduced and discussed in class lectures.

metadata.chunk_title: Module Code - Title: + Year Last Offered: + Hours Per Week: + Grading Type: + Prerequisite Modules: + Rationale and Purpose of the Module:

facts.value: The module comprises four distinct but interrelated themes, each dealt with in sequential blocks over the twelve week module.
Nature of language and linguistics: Introduction to basic concepts in linguistics, including language, duality, arbitrariness.
Phonetics & Phonology: Recognition and categorization of the sounds of English and other languages.
Morpho-Syntax: Focus on how words are formed and how they combine to make sentences.
Semantics and Pragmatics: Focus on meaning and its relevance to the study of language.
Understand the purpose of linguistic study, including phonetics, phonology, morphology, syntax and semantics.
